related.title: Open Policy Agent：拒絕預設與授權真值表
related.titleEn: Open Policy Agent: default deny and authorization truth tables
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：有效與續期界線分開，兩種餘裕可重算；報告不包含keytab、票證本體或真實使用者識別。 交付票證流程、時間線及主體/kvno對照表，秘密保持在測試環境。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Validity and renewal boundaries remain separate, both margins are reproducible, and reports contain no keytabs, ticket bodies or real user identifiers. Deliver ticket flow, timeline and principal/kvno mapping while keeping secrets inside the test environment.
related.difference: 建立三個角色、四種資源、兩種動作的授權矩陣；先把需要允許的格子明確列出，缺值與未知角色走拒絕。
related.differenceEn: Build an authorization matrix with three roles, four resources and two actions; enumerate allowed cells explicitly and deny missing values or unknown roles.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 剩餘有效期=endtime−now，不能用renew-till代替endtime；票證可更新不代表過期票證仍能直接使用。 合成服務票證endtime=7200秒、now=3600秒、renew-till=14400秒。 可用餘裕7200−3600=3600秒；將endtime縮為5400秒後餘裕1800秒。
完整笛卡兒積測試數=角色數×資源數×動作數；測試覆蓋不等於每格都允許，缺少測試也不能解讀為拒絕正確。 基準3角色、4資源、2動作；每組合建立一筆本機JSON輸入和預期布林結果。 3×4×2=24項；增加一個唯讀角色後4×4×2=32項，原24項需全部保留。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Remaining validity is endtime−now, not renew-till−now; renewable tickets are not automatically usable after expiry. A synthetic service ticket has endtime=7200 seconds, now=3600 and renew-till=14400. Margin is 7200−3600=3600 seconds; shortening endtime to 5400 leaves 1800 seconds.

Complete Cartesian tests equal roles×resources×actions; coverage does not mean every case allows, and an untested cell is not a proven denial. Baseline: 3 roles, 4 resources and 2 actions, each combination represented by local JSON and an expected Boolean. 3×4×2=24 tests; adding a read-only role gives 4×4×2=32, retaining all original 24.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: DNSSEC：信任鏈與金鑰輪替等待
related.titleEn: DNSSEC: trust chains and rollover waits
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：有效與續期界線分開，兩種餘裕可重算；報告不包含keytab、票證本體或真實使用者識別。 交付票證流程、時間線及主體/kvno對照表，秘密保持在測試環境。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Validity and renewal boundaries remain separate, both margins are reproducible, and reports contain no keytabs, ticket bodies or real user identifiers. Deliver ticket flow, timeline and principal/kvno mapping while keeping secrets inside the test environment.
related.difference: 為example.test畫出DNSKEY、DS、RRSIG及RRset關係；用時間線比較驗證器快取的舊資料與新簽章可見時刻。
related.differenceEn: Map DNSKEY, DS, RRSIG and RRsets for example.test; compare cached old data with new-signature visibility on a timeline.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 剩餘有效期=endtime−now，不能用renew-till代替endtime；票證可更新不代表過期票證仍能直接使用。 合成服務票證endtime=7200秒、now=3600秒、renew-till=14400秒。 可用餘裕7200−3600=3600秒；將endtime縮為5400秒後餘裕1800秒。
本題單一RRset的保守等待下限=舊TTL+時鐘誤差裕度；完整輪替還需考慮父區DS與其他快取，不能只套此一算式。 教學RRset舊TTL3600秒，時鐘裕度300秒；本題不模擬父區更新。 3600+300=3900秒；舊TTL改7200秒時下限7500秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Remaining validity is endtime−now, not renew-till−now; renewable tickets are not automatically usable after expiry. A synthetic service ticket has endtime=7200 seconds, now=3600 and renew-till=14400. Margin is 7200−3600=3600 seconds; shortening endtime to 5400 leaves 1800 seconds.

A conservative wait lower bound for one RRset is old TTL plus clock-error margin; complete rollover also considers parent DS and other caches. A teaching RRset has old TTL 3600 seconds and clock margin 300 seconds; parent-zone updates are outside this calculation. 3600+300=3900 seconds; old TTL 7200 gives a 7500-second lower bound.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
